new_result.statement: For a physical cross block M and six-row set R, define a_S=sum_T det(M[S,T])^2 and C_R=sum_{|S|=3} sqrt(a_S a_{R\S}). If C_R>0 then ||p_Q||_inf <=3e C_R^(-1/6), with a C0 density in the weighted-three-volume theorem scope.
new_result.exact_identity: The complement-Hellinger row law mu(S)=sqrt(a_S a_{R\S})/C_R has row marginals 1/2; canonical conditional column weights produce G(w)=C_R exactly; C_R/Z_R is the Bhattacharyya affinity with the complement image and KL(mu||p_R)=log(Z_R/C_R).
new_result.partner_application: Partner base-packing theorem implies C_R>0 exactly compiles a two-disjoint-base support packet into q=1 Fourier currency; on the partner equal-minor example C_R=64 and the compiler reproduces 3e/2.
new_result.explicit_target_example: M=U diag(4,2,1)V^T with six-row U and dense orthogonal V; A=[[0,M],[M^T,0]] has spectrum +/-4,+/-2,+/-1,0,0,0, all 18 cross entries nonzero, Z_R=64, C_R=32sqrt(3), giving ||p||inf<=4.17635398765184 and ||phi||1<=26.240806012794916.
